Population decreased in the Derbyshire Dales

The estimated population of the Derbyshire Dales in 2024 was 71,757 usual residents, a fall of 0.3% since 2023.

This meant that the Derbyshire Dales was among one of only eleven local authorities in England and Wales where the population got smaller.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of the Derbyshire Dales increased by 0.1%.

Over this slightly longer period, the Derbyshire Dales was also among the 20% slowest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of the Derbyshire Dales

The average (median) age rose to 53.2 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of the Derbyshire Dales has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
The Derbyshire Dales is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, the Derbyshire Dales' population of 71,757 usual residents was made up of:

  • 10,111 people aged 0 to 15 years, (14.1%)
  • 40,615 people aged 16 to 64 years, (56.6%)
  • 21,031 people aged 65 years and over, (29.3%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, the Derbyshire Dales has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (29.3% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In the Derbyshire Dales, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from births and deaths.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in the Derbyshire Dales
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for the Derbyshire Dales, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 476 people (-0.7%). In total, there were 393 births and 869 deaths in the Derbyshire Dales.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 232 (0.3%). There were 4,300 people entering the area and 4,068 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in the Derbyshire Dales' population of 98 (0.1%) as a result of 215 people entering the area and 117 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for the Derbyshire Dales was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of the Derbyshire Dales in mid-2023 is 71,946.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 80 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 336 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 416 people.
